canonical.intent: Single Murf Studio product detail. API, Agents and Dub are excluded. No new entities, Task URLs, or additional aliases. The local legacy murf-ai slug resolves to murf in each locale and comparison content uses murf; production redirects and references still require post-deploy QA.

identity.statement: Browser Studio produces editable narration from scripts with media alignment; API latency, agent telephony and Dub download rights do not apply. Account signup exists; no login, synthesis, purchase or regional availability test performed.

price.statement: Monthly and annual Studio views were separated in browser. Public candidate copy omits amounts and quota promises because checkout, account cohort, tax and conflicting help entries remain unverified. Annual monthly-equivalent is not a monthly charge.

free.statement: Free trial: 10 one-time VGT minutes, 10 transcription minutes per help, no card, no download/export or commercial license. Preview/share/embed availability is not download entitlement.

plans.statement: Observed Studio cards: Free 10 projects/1 editor; Creator 100/1, 2h monthly or 24h yearly; Business 500/1, 8h monthly or 96h yearly; Enterprise custom projects/editors and advertised unlimited generation. Exact entitlements require account confirmation. No Growth card observed.

features.statement: Creator card has downloads/Canva/commercial rights. Business adds business license, emphasis, variability, Say It My Way, PowerPoint and transcription (table: 4h monthly/48h yearly). Enterprise adds invited collaboration, SSO, private access controls, translation, MSA and no-training statement; clones and full broadcast rights are add-ons. Shared preview is distinct from editing access.

usage.statement: VGT measures newly generated or text-modified sub-block duration, not just final exported minutes. Help excludes settings-only changes. Project slots are concurrent holdings, not monthly credits. Annual FAQ says annual pool without monthly limits but uses legacy Basic example; verify account. Carryover lasts only the following billing cycle; cancellation forfeits unused VGT.

commercial.statement: Paid Studio includes commercial voiceover use; individual personal license covers small commercial work, business license is recommended for organizations. Broadcast TV/radio rights require Enterprise and current pricing marks them add-on: not automatic with Enterprise. Third-party platforms decide acceptance/monetization. Terms prohibit reselling Murf offerings and using its voices to train AI.

inputRights.statement: User must clear scripts/uploads and obtain written speaker consent for cloning. Stock media is described as royalty-free, not rights-free: YouTube stock music requires a one-use code in the description; no standalone music export. Exact third-party asset license, attribution, territories and post-subscription reuse were not independently established. Do not extend voiceover licensing to arbitrary music/images or Murf logos.

export.statement: Paid voice export: MP3/WAV/FLAC and telephony a-law/u-law; mixed voice+music is a single file, with OGG additionally listed. Video MP4/MOV supports subtitles and SRT/VTT scripts. Paid table says unlimited downloads, not unlimited generation; Full HD is observed, not tested. Cancellation help ends rendering/download access at billing-cycle end, whereas security describes retrieval of previously generated audio up to 90 days after agreement end. Applicability to ordinary Studio, cancellation versus termination and retrieval mechanism remain unresolved; neither is an unconditional entitlement or cutoff.

durationSync.statement: Import help distinguishes unrestricted Add Media uploads from 45-minute Audio to Text entry and 15000 words per script upload (SRT exception). These are entry limits, not final-runtime guarantees. Three tracks support block alignment; media is left-aligned and video cannot extend beyond its source length. No lip-sync, long-project SLA or per-plan final duration ceiling verified.

languages.statement: Language doc lists Mandarin and Cantonese; voice styles vary by voice. Official total counts conflict internally and across pages, so no exact catalog count or Taiwan-accent guarantee. EN/CN/TW below are editorial localizations, not proof of localized product UI.

privacy.statement: Studio inputs are collected to provide service; general terms protect confidential content with service-provider access/exceptions. Privacy policy allows global processing, account/service retention and legal/security exceptions. Deletion requests receive a response within 30 days, not guaranteed total deletion. Security lifecycle statements specify backup deletion and complex-case timing; applicability differences are recorded under deletion scenarios, not treated as absent. Enterprise no-training card is not a guarantee for ordinary Studio; their training/opt-out scope remains unknown.

deletion.statement: Subscription cancellation, account termination, deletion requests and backup erasure have different triggers and data scopes. Official 30/90-day statements conflict in applicability; no unified deletion deadline or post-contract retrieval promise is verified. Project trash/recovery windows are not account deletion policies. No deletion or retrieval exercise performed.

en.summary: Murf Studio turns scripts into editable AI narration with a media timeline for lessons, explainers and product demos. Downloading and commercial delivery require a paid plan.
en.detail:
Use the browser Studio to split a script into blocks, choose a voice, adjust pronunciation and pacing, and align narration with video or images. This is a candidate for repeatable course narration when a person can review the finished audio. It is separate from Murf API, conversational Agents and Dub.

Try a representative script before choosing a subscription. Changes to text can consume generation time again, and project slots differ from generation minutes. Paid download access does not imply unlimited synthesis or broadcast rights. Plan-specific documents put invited collaboration in Enterprise; a preview link is not another editor seat. No synthesis or account checkout was tested in this review.

Cancellation help says download access ends at billing-cycle end; the security page describes up to 90 days after agreement end to retrieve existing audio. Their scope and retrieval method remain unresolved; do not assume either universal cutoff or guaranteed continued access.
bestFor: Course authors who revise narration in sections and check pronunciation against the script.
Individuals producing explainers with licensed media who can pay for exports and review timing.
notIdealFor: Anyone needing free downloadable commercial voiceovers.
Teams expecting multiple editors, TV/radio rights or a documented no-training commitment in every self-serve plan.
Real-time voice-agent/API projects or workflows requiring proven lip-sync and fully unattended multilingual quality.
limitations: Text edits can consume VGT again; budget for revisions rather than only the final runtime.
Official pages disagree on project limits, voice/language totals and some plan features; confirm the actual account and order.
Broadcast rights are an Enterprise add-on; stock media and uploaded scripts require their own rights checks.
Review names, numbers, accents and synchronization; no quality benchmark was run here.

Cancellation help says download access ends at billing-cycle end; the security page describes up to 90 days after agreement end to retrieve existing audio. Their scope and retrieval method remain unresolved; do not assume either universal cutoff or guaranteed continued access.
en.pricingBoundary: Free Studio offers a one-time 10-minute voice-generation trial with no downloads or commercial license. Paid Creator and Business plans have monthly and annual billing; annual headline monthly equivalents are paid yearly. Exact prices and quota promises are omitted pending account/checkout confirmation and reconciliation of help-page conflicts. Enterprise is custom; collaboration and broadcast add-ons need explicit scope.
en.privacyBoundary: Separate subscription cancellation, account termination, deletion requests and backup erasure. The privacy policy specifies account deletion within 30 days after termination with exceptions; security states automatic deletion within 90 days without a request and requested deletion including backups up to 90 days in complex cases. A 30-day request response is separate. These scopes remain unresolved, not a universal deadline. Ordinary Studio training/opt-out scope remains unverified; Enterprise commitments do not transfer.
en.platforms: Browser Studio account; this review covers its public documentation and pricing UI. No native app, offline operation, regional availability or mobile feature parity was validated.

decisionCard.verdict: Shortlist for reviewed script-to-narration work if paid exports and plan limits fit.
decisionCard.chooseIf: You can test a course excerpt, revise it in small blocks, and verify delivery rights.
decisionCard.skipIf: Free exports, shared editing on a self-serve plan, or included broadcast rights are mandatory.
decisionCard.firstCheck: Test names, numbers and target accents; inspect VGT after text revisions and verify export format, project slots, seats and license on the intended account. Before cancellation or termination, confirm existing-audio retrieval and deletion scope with Murf.

Their scope and retrieval method remain unresolved; do not assume either universal cutoff or guaranteed continued access.

tw.privacyBoundary: 須分開取消訂閱、終止帳戶、刪除請求與備份刪除。隱私政策稱帳戶終止後 30 天內刪除並列例外；安全頁稱無請求時 90 天內自動刪除，請求刪除包含備份，複雜情況最長 90 天。請求 30 天內回覆另計。適用範圍衝突待核，不能統一為刪除期限。一般 Studio 訓練/退出範圍仍未核實，不外推 Enterprise 承諾。
tw.platforms: 瀏覽器 Studio 帳戶；本次涵蓋公開文件與定價介面。未驗證原生應用程式、離線使用、地區可用性或行動版功能是否一致。
